'''Ponche de crème''' is a seasonal beverage usually enjoyed as a cocktail at Christmastime. It is similar to [[Cookbook:Eggnog|eggnog]].

==Ingredients==
*6 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*peel of 1 [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]]
*3 cans (15 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 400 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Condensed milk|evaporated milk]]
*1½ cans (14 oz / 380 g) [[Cookbook:Condensed milk|sweetened condensed milk]], or to taste
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] aromatic bitters
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|grated nutmeg]]
*½ cup (120 ml) [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]] or [[Cookbook:Brandy|brandy]], or to taste

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] eggs and lime peel until light and fluffy.
# Add evaporated milk.
# Sweeten to taste with condensed milk.
# Add bitters, grated nutmeg and rum according to taste.
# Remove lime peel and serve over crushed ice.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Instead of beating the raw eggs, you can gently stir them together with the other ingredients over a low heat until the mixture thickens (about 20–25 minutes).
